title: Reject incomplete or concurrently changed atomic recovery reads
description: P1 robustness review: atomic JSON backup/journal/artifact readers issue one os.read but do not require the returned length to equal the fstat snapshot. A short read can publish a truncated rollback backup, while concurrent same-bound growth/shrink can make recovery operate on a non-snapshot. Require exact stable lengths (with max+1 growth detection) and add failure-injection tests.
close_reason: Fixed: announce/persistence.py _read_state now requires len(raw)==fstat snapshot AND post-read re-fstat unchanged. 4 failure-injection tests (short read, growth, growth-past-cap, shrink). 236 announce tests pass. Same-pattern in key_persistence/dao_persistence slots is mitigated downstream by checksum/HMAC+anchor validation and tracked for review.
